items.title: Kering stock stabilizes after modest H1 2026 return to growth
items.summary: German financial-press follow-up dated Aug 19 characterizing Kering's H1 2026 recovery as "fragile": group revenue reached EUR 7.22bn (+1% like-for-like) but the piece stresses this growth is being carried by jewelry/eyewear and other houses rather than a full Gucci rebound, since Gucci's Q2 comparable sales still fell 2% and the division "remains below its prior-year revenue levels." Stock closed around EUR 257.10 on Aug 17, down 14.6% year-to-date despite the recent bounce.

items.title: HSBC upgrades Kering to Buy, raises target to EUR 340 after Gucci beat
items.summary: Sell-side coverage of HSBC's post-Q2-earnings upgrade of Kering to "Buy" (target raised from EUR 290 to EUR 340), citing Gucci's narrower-than-expected 2% comparable sales decline and US leather-goods strength (Borsetto, Paparazzo bags) as evidence the reset is gaining traction. Balanced by the fact other desks (including HSBC itself, in an earlier note) had flagged the turnaround as slower than hoped, underscoring how split analyst sentiment on Gucci remains even after a good quarter.

items.title: Entre problemes de qualite et omnipresence des produits, Gucci contraint de revoir sa strategie
items.summary: Swiss public-broadcaster economics piece on Gucci's near-halving of revenue (EUR10.5bn in 2022 to ~EUR6bn) and Q1 2026 -14% decline to EUR1.35bn. Sector analysts quoted attribute lost desirability to "quality problems," an over-large streetwear share of collections, and GG-logo overexposure versus rivals that cultivate rarity. Confirms Kering's plan for roughly 275 Gucci store closures between 2025-2027 to refocus on flagships and quality. A clearly critical-angle piece, useful counterweight to earnings-recovery coverage.

items.title: Brand Finance Italy 2026: Gucci perd un quart de sa valeur au classement
items.summary: French luxury trade coverage of the Brand Finance Italy 100 2026 ranking: Gucci's brand value fell -25.3% to EUR7.6bn, dropping the house from 3rd to 5th place among Italian brands, while Q1 revenues fell -8% to EUR1.3bn. Included despite being outside the ideal freshness window because it is still actively cited/re-shared in current EU trade commentary on Gucci's valuation slide and no fresher restatement of this specific ranking was found; flagged here as an older but still-referenced data point rather than breaking news.

items.title: Milano Fashion Week settembre 2026: calendario e novita - Gucci confermato il 25 settembre
items.summary: Italian fashion-calendar coverage confirming Gucci returns to the Milan runway calendar on Friday, September 25, 2026 at 2pm, marking Demna's second ready-to-wear appointment for the house. Framed by the outlet as a key test of whether the initial buzz around "Generation Gucci"/La Famiglia converts into a durable, recognizable identity for Kering's largest brand -- forward-looking anticipation coverage rather than a staged brand push.

items.title: Gucci.com customer reviews on Trustpilot (France) -- recurring quality/service complaints
items.summary: Ongoing consumer-review thread (1,600+ reviews) on Gucci's official e-commerce, skewing negative: recurring complaints include canvas cutting/handles warping within months, a scarf tearing after three weeks with customer service refusing repair or exchange, seams coming undone, hardware tarnishing, and lost/delayed online orders with unresponsive support. Genuine grassroots community signal on product-quality perception, corroborating the quality-complaint angle also raised in T2 trade press.

items.title: Kate Moss's G-string Gucci runway look continues circulating on TikTok
items.summary: Italian fashion-media TikTok account (nssmagazine) reposting Kate Moss's backless, thong-detail closing look from Demna's Gucci debut show, captioned playfully ("oh we're so back"). Comment sentiment on similar reposts of this clip remains mixed months after the original show -- some praise Moss as still iconic, others call the back of the dress unflattering -- indicating the clip still has organic recirculation life on European fashion TikTok. Exact like/view/comment counts not visible via public search and are recorded as null rather than estimated.

items.title: La Famiglia campaign clip recirculating on fashion-media Instagram
items.summary: Verified fashion-media account 10magazine reposting Demna's La Famiglia campaign for Gucci (shot by Catherine Opie, featuring Demi Moore and other cast members); visible comment thread shows a mix of reactions including some criticism questioning design originality alongside supportive comments from industry-adjacent accounts. Exact like/view counts not displayed in the accessible view and are recorded as null.

items.title: PurseForum thread: 2026 Gucci Flora reissue under Demna
items.summary: Handbag-collector community thread discussing the Flora print's reappearance in Gucci's 2026 assortment under Demna, with members sharing US-site product snippets and photos and debating whether the archival print revival signals a genuine design direction or a safe nostalgia play. Represents core-collector community sentiment distinct from mainstream press or brand social channels; forum could not be directly fetched (403) so detail is based on indexed search-result excerpts only.
